rationale: Both use the same board parsing, the same DFS and the same hex neighbor offsets. B's _has_path takes explicit lists of start and end cells, which keeps the search generic and makes each call site self-explanatory. A passes strings such as 'left' and 'right' and branches on them inside the helper; this stringly-typed approach is fragile, because an unexpected value silently falls into the other branch. B's neighbor helper uses a clean delta tuple with a labeled comment. A has a nicer class docstring, but B's interface design is cleaner overall.
